topic: CI/CD, Performance, Security, and Production Readiness
learningObjectives: Explain the basic stages of a CI/CD pipeline.
Identify performance and security improvements for production applications.
Evaluate application readiness using production-focused checks.

activities.title: CI/CD Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a deployment pipeline.

content.concept: A CI/CD pipeline can automate code validation, testing, building, and deployment after changes are submitted.

activities.title: Security Checkpoint
activities.instruction: Identify security controls for common application risks.

content.concept: Production applications should protect authentication, user input, secrets, APIs, and stored data against common security risks.
